rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Telecom Subscription Velocity — DL-0184")`
`comment("Detects multiple new service activations from same identity/device within 30 days")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:account_activations
  activation_type="new_account"
| bin _time span=30d
| stats count as activation_count,
        dc(carrier_id) as unique_carriers,
        dc(device_imei) as unique_devices,
        values(carrier_id) as carriers,
        values(device_imei) as devices,
        values(device_model) as device_models,
        values(plan_type) as plan_types,
        sum(device_value) as total_device_value,
        earliest(_time) as first_activation,
        latest(_time) as last_activation
  by identity_hash, _time
| where activation_count >= 3 OR unique_carriers >= 2
| eval risk_score = case(
    activation_count >= 5 AND unique_carriers >= 3, "critical",
    activation_count >= 4 AND total_device_value > 5000, "high",
    activation_count >= 3 OR unique_carriers >= 2, "medium")
| eval days_between = round((last_activation - first_activation) / 86400, 1)
| table identity_hash, activation_count, unique_carriers, unique_devices,
        carriers, devices, device_models, plan_types, total_device_value,
        first_activation, last_activation, days_between, risk_score
| sort - activation_count
rules.title: DL-0184: Telecom Subscription Velocity — Multiple New Service Activations From Same Identity/Device Within 30 Days (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Premium SMS Billing Anomaly — DL-0185")`
`comment("Detects unauthorized premium SMS subscriptions appearing on accounts")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:billing
  (charge_type="premium_sms" OR charge_type="premium_content"
   OR charge_type="shortcode_subscription")
| lookup premium_sms_opt_in account_id, shortcode OUTPUT opt_in_date, opt_in_channel
| where isnull(opt_in_date)
| bin _time span=30d
| stats dc(shortcode) as unique_shortcodes,
        count as charge_count,
        sum(charge_amount) as total_charges,
        values(shortcode) as shortcodes,
        values(content_provider) as content_providers,
        values(billing_source) as billing_sources,
        earliest(subscription_start_date) as first_subscription,
        latest(subscription_start_date) as last_subscription
  by account_id, customer_name, _time
| where unique_shortcodes >= 2
| eval risk_score = case(
    unique_shortcodes >= 5 AND total_charges > 100, "critical",
    unique_shortcodes >= 3 AND total_charges > 50, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, customer_name, unique_shortcodes, charge_count,
        total_charges, shortcodes, content_providers, billing_sources,
        first_subscription, last_subscription, risk_score
| sort - unique_shortcodes
rules.title: DL-0185: Premium SMS Billing Anomaly — Unauthorized Premium SMS Subscriptions Appearing on Accounts (SPLUNK)
